scope.spend_estimate_basis: reconstructed from pod createdAt/deletedAt timestamps and $0.49/GPU-hour rate across all attempts; not an authoritative RunPod billing statement -- confirm exact figure in the RunPod dashboard

deviation_from_authorized_plan.what_changed: The authorized plan specified using the custom-built, GHCR-published image fixed by digest (ghcr.io/hackerprod/omega-core-lm-0-r1@sha256:b6834274f18d9dceaa2f5983a9ebfa099d13a2265a6e607303ca1324284ce4e7). That image could not be used.
deviation_from_authorized_plan.why: RunPod's pod-creation tool available in this session has no parameter for private-registry authentication (no containerRegistryAuthId equivalent), so pulling the private GHCR image failed immediately (pod exited ~2s after creation, 'manifest unavailable' class failure). A fallback attempt using the raw public pytorch/pytorch base image (no custom layer) created a pod that never exposed a working SSH server, because that image has no sshd baked in -- only the custom GHCR image does.
deviation_from_authorized_plan.what_was_used_instead: RunPod's own maintained public template image runpod/pytorch:2.4.0-py3.11-cuda12.4.1-devel-ubuntu22.04, which ships a working SSH server out of the box. All OMEGA-specific software was then installed at runtime over that live SSH connection: the public GitHub repository (github.com/Hackerprod/Ejercise, confirmed public via an unauthenticated GitHub API request returning HTTP 200) was git-cloned directly onto the pod, and torch==2.11.0 was reinstalled explicitly from https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu128 to match the exact pinned CUDA 12.8 variant (a bare `pip install torch==2.11.0` from requirements.lock alone silently resolved to a cu130 build incompatible with this host's driver -- caught via `torch.cuda.is_available()` returning False, fixed with a --force-reinstall against the explicit cu128 index).
deviation_from_authorized_plan.what_did_not_change: R1 architecture (frozen, untouched), CE/KL distillation loss, temperature, effective batch 8 / physical microbatch 2 / four accumulations, gradient clipping at norm 1.0 applied once per update, AdamW with constant LR 3e-4, weight_decay=0, FP32 (no AMP, no quantization), the three variants (shared_K1, shared_K4, untied_K4), and the exact pinned dependency versions (torch 2.11.0+cu128, transformers 5.4.0, datasets 4.8.5, tokenizers 0.22.2, huggingface-hub 1.8.0, safetensors 0.7.0, psutil 7.2.2) -- confirmed installed and verified against requirements.lock inside the pod before running anything.
deviation_from_authorized_plan.custom_ghcr_image_status: Still built, verified, and published (see omega_core_lm_0_r1_vps_builder_and_image_validation/ and the launch_readiness registry_publication_evidence.json) -- unaffected by this deviation. It remains the intended artifact for a future, longer training run once RunPod registry-auth or public visibility is resolved; this preflight did not need it to gather real CUDA timing/feasibility evidence.

real_bug_found_and_fixed_during_executio.bug_1: Took dataset[0] directly as the fixed preflight text. The first row of the WikiText-2-raw-v1 train split is an empty string, so this raised 'fixed dataset first record has no usable text' before any GPU work started.
real_bug_found_and_fixed_during_executio.bug_2_after_first_fix_attempt: A quick fix that scanned for the first non-empty, non-header row of at least 200 characters found a real but short (163-token) paragraph. Window 2 (positions 257:513) requires real content past token 257, so the entire target_masks[1] mask was zero for every sequence, raising 'at least one valid target required' on update index 1 (the first update using window 1).
real_bug_found_and_fixed_during_executio.final_fix: Scans dataset rows for the first non-header, non-empty candidate of at least 1600 characters, tokenizes it, and requires at least 400 real tokens (safely covering both 256-token windows) before accepting it. Verified directly: the accepted record produced target_masks[0].sum()=1304 for window 0 and, per the successful run, non-zero valid targets for window 1 across all 21 updates (see per-update valid_tokens=1352 in every completed event below).
real_bug_found_and_fixed_during_executio.scope_of_fix: Only affects the ad-hoc single-document preflight source selection used by this narrow CUDA-timing/feasibility check. Does not touch, and is unrelated to, the previously-validated reconstruct_documents()/is_level_one_header() document-selection logic in run_omega_core_lm_0_r1_training_technical_preflight.py, which remains the correct mechanism for the real multi-document training run.
real_bug_found_and_fixed_during_executio.applied_directly_on_the_pod_then_synced_: Both fixes were applied live via SSH on the running (billed) pod to avoid wasting GPU time on a red-yellow-green edit/redeploy cycle, then the final version was copied byte-for-byte back into the repository's omega_nominal_microbatch_runner.py after the run succeeded and the pod was released.

environment_verified_on_pod.pip_check: No broken requirements found (after pinning fsspec<=2026.2.0 to satisfy datasets' declared upper bound; fsspec is a transitive dependency, not one of the fixed requirements.lock entries)
